differences.a_observable: Dappled shadows from tree leaves are cast across the tiles, creating organic dark and light patterns.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is uniform and clean, with no organic leaf shadows visible on the tiles.
differences.fix: Add a gobo or light cookie with a leaf pattern to the main light source to project dappled shadows.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles, such as the 'Secure Payments' tile, are blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles remain in sharp focus, indicating a deep depth of field.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and decrease the f-stop to blur the background elements.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Add dappled leaf shadows using a light gobo and enable camera depth of field to match the organic look and focus of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: The camera is closer to the cards, making the 'Recurly' and 'Juspay' cards dominate the frame.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away, showing more background tiles and making the cards appear smaller.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length to match the reference framing.

differences.a_observable: Soft, dark contact shadows ground the cards onto the background tiles.
differences.b_observable: Contact shadows are nearly absent, making the cards look flat and floating.
differences.fix: Enable ambient occlusion and strengthen contact shadows under the cards.

differences.a_observable: The 'Recurly' card features a warm, saturated golden-yellow hue.
differences.b_observable: The 'Recurly' card has a cooler, desaturated greenish-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the yellow material's hue and saturation to match the reference.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera distance and focal length to match the reference framing, and increase the overall contrast and contact shadow strength to eliminate the flat, washed-out look.

differences.a_observable: The camera is tilted at an oblique angle with a shallow depth of field blurring the background.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned directly overhead with a deep depth of field keeping all elements in focus.
differences.fix: Tilt the camera to match the oblique perspective and enable depth of field.

differences.a_observable: The white cards and background exhibit a cool, blue-tinted color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white cards and background are neutral white with no blue tint.
differences.fix: Apply a cool blue color grade to the scene.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center due to a vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are bright and uniform with the center.
differences.fix: Introduce a vignette effect to darken the corners.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle to match the oblique perspective and enable depth of field.
